summary: Living room is well kept, but unanchored tall items present tip-over and path hazards.

hazards.title: Tall Plant Tip-Over Risk
hazards.detail: Large top-heavy potted plant could topple easily if bumped or pulled.
fixSteps: Use a heavier, wider base pot to lower center of gravity.
Secure the plant stem or pot lightly to the nearby wall if possible.

hazards.title: Unanchored Credenza
hazards.detail: Tall sideboard holds lamps and books without visible wall anchors.
fixSteps: Install anti-tip safety straps connecting the unit to wall studs.
Distribute heavy stored items across bottom cabinets only.

hazards.title: Area Rug Edge Trip Hazard
hazards.detail: Slightly raised or curling edge of area rug along common walking path.
fixSteps: Affix double-sided rug tape along all perimeter edges.
Add a non-slip rug pad underneath to ensure flat placement.

products.name: Furniture Anti-Tip Straps
products.reason: Anchors the sideboard securely against the wall to prevent tipping.
